data.description: The PowerUp.ts script the comment says 'Power-up base class and round-robin spawner (GDD §4.4, GDD §6.4).' The gym scene should use a round robin spawner but in-game we will use a semi-random spawning approach. We need to separate the spawning algorithm out and make it pluggable so that the gym can have round robin and the main game can have a different approach (initially purely random).
data.title: In-Game spawning should not be round robin

data.author: Map
data.comment:
Intake questions:

1. **What does "semi-random" mean?** Should it be:
   - A: Pure random selection from available power-up types (P1-P9)
   - B: Weighted random (some power-ups spawn more frequently than others)
   - C: Random with constraints (e.g., no two weapon power-ups in a row, guaranteed life drops every N spawns)

2. **Does the in-game scene already exist and use the current round-robin spawner**, or is this a preparatory refactor before the in-game scene is built?

3. **Are there constraints on spawn positions** for the in-game scene (e.g., random positions vs. predefined positions like the gym's SPAWN_POSITIONS)?

— Map
